inherited_methods.method: audited fractional cover plus generic dependent rounding
inherited_methods.loss_step: replace the prime-labelled intersection pattern of bad events by edge weights and an abstract dependency graph
inherited_methods.lost_information: whether shared valuation rows compress whole clusters or instead propagate one cofactor residue through them
inherited_methods.consequence: generic set-cover or LLL losses are not proved o(log N), so the N/log N fractional mass does not become o(N) integrally

inherited_methods.loss_step: balance the top-prime incidence counts and then discard the signed products of the stripped cofactors
inherited_methods.lost_information: an arbitrary rational residue that continues to couple lower-prime fibres
inherited_methods.consequence: 2*3=6 already refutes residue-free triangularity; retaining the full residue risks re-encoding the original relation

inherited_methods.loss_step: declare the state smaller because its largest prime was stripped, without measuring support propagation across other tokens
inherited_methods.lost_information: global component diameter, fan size, and whether the same imbalance simply moves to the next prime
inherited_methods.consequence: ordered active-prime paths can have arbitrary length even when every integer has active degree at most two

inherited_methods.loss_step: compress a circuit to maximum active degree, cycle rank, bounded radius, or a finite residue signature
inherited_methods.lost_information: connected-tree support length and arbitrary products carried by the two endpoints of a peeled prime
inherited_methods.consequence: tree and low-degree comparators can themselves be support-minimal unequal relations

inherited_methods.loss_step: freeze lower-prime decisions before accounting for relations created by a later larger prime
inherited_methods.lost_information: cross-scale completion of any two lower products by a new balanced top-prime pair
inherited_methods.consequence: monotone no-revision stabilization needs a reserved deletion or isolation mechanism, not just pointwise convergence

required_new_information: For alteration: a full-component arithmetic witness compression with total repair cost o(log N) times the audited fractional mass.
For ownership: a top-prime plus complete cofactor-residue owner whose aggregate load is o(log N), including long active-incidence trees.
For recursion: a potential that decreases under global residue propagation rather than under a single prime removal only.
For coherence: a reserve or revision scheme that controls future larger-prime completions and proves an actual natural-density limit.
For negative progress: an all-parameter rough high-tail circuit or universal residue extension against a precisely frozen local/depth claim.

new_adversarial_hosts.name: rough ordered path circuit
new_adversarial_hosts.description: A connected odd path with distinct increasing primes p>N^(1/L) on its edges, balanced nonuniform 2-adic padding, active degree at most two, and arbitrary support length inside the strict high tail.
new_adversarial_hosts.tests: bounded depth, forest safety, active-degree compression, and residue propagation

new_adversarial_hosts.name: universal double-star residue extension
new_adversarial_hosts.description: For disjoint prime sets A,B and a new top prime p, the shores A union {p prod B} and B union {p prod A} form a minimal relation; stripping p transfers the arbitrary residue prod B/prod A.
new_adversarial_hosts.tests: bounded residue alphabet, cofactor-gcd splitting, and monotone prime-prefix stabilization
